plan: This is a sealed-bid second-price auction. With rational bidders, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly below your true value. Since this is the first round, I have no prior information about the other bidders' behavior. I will bid a bit below my value to start. I will bid 23.5.
This is a single-round auction. The Nash Equilibrium strategy in a second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid truthfully. This means bidding my true value. Since my value is $16, I will bid $16.00.

I will use the Nash Equilibrium strategy. With 3 bidders, the optimal bidding strategy is to bid two-thirds of my value. My value is $24, so I will bid (2/3) * 24 = $16. This strategy assumes the other bidders are also rational and using a similar strategy.
